artifacts.notes: The actual 1859 source supplies Baptismo and innocentiae odore, with its original ligature spelling. It is not a repair of Wilson 1894 baptismum or innocens odor. The full older consecration prayer continues ut sit his after this bounded cut; no claim is made that the 1859 source prints the later assembled Missal Preface whole.
